title_zh: 这一拍，给下一拍留下什么？
source_scope: Three selected passages from an edited China Open 2025 women's singles final reel, not the complete match.
analysis_mode: Retrospective editorial analysis based on inspected continuous source sequences and real cached pose. Not an accepted automatic contact detector or a prospective prediction evaluation.
limits: The V2 automatic contact accuracy gates are not passed; selection does not change that result.
No shuttle trajectory, racket contact sensor, player's intention or precise three-dimensional biomechanics is measured.
Short/deep replies are interpretations of the visible exchange, not measured shuttle landing locations.
Book collection and independent script review are separate requirements, not implied by this script.
Keep original watermarks and attribution. Upstream broadcast rights for public redistribution have not been independently cleared.

presentation.framing: Keep both players, the whole playable court and existing attribution visible; do not crop into a single-player talking-point montage.
presentation.sequence: Show each passage once in increasing source-time order. Slow selected decisions, allow brief holds, then show the actual reply. Do not replay the same action.
presentation.overlays: Use real player tracks for brief position/travel cues and pose only at useful instants. Label any arrows as player movement, never shuttle flight.
presentation.pose_limit: Only sufficiently supported real joints; suppress obscured joints. Never project airborne ankles as precise floor locations.
presentation.text: Short lesson title plus one changing observation, not the full spoken paragraph. Identify players by red/gray shirts; near/far changes after the end switch.
presentation.audio: Local neural Chinese voice, with actual synthesized duration determining the edit. Preserve quiet court audio where available; do not invent impact sounds.
presentation.ending: Two short takeaway lines while the final rally continues; do not imply that the last shown attack won the rally.

moments.title_zh: 不是救这一球，是被连续调动
observed_sequence: Red-shirt player moves toward the front, then reaches the near rear-right around 60.65 seconds.
The following exchange sends her to a low forward-left reach around 62.05 seconds.
She gets up and the rally continues. The low rescue itself is not presented as the point-ending shot.
do_not_claim: Gray-shirt player read the opponent's mind or planned the entire rally.
A measured shuttle landing or exact three-dimensional travel distance.
The dive itself caused the point loss.

observed_sequence: Red-shirt player is on or very close to the floor after a low forward-left rescue around 128.05 seconds.
She rises and recovers before the gray-shirt opponent's rear-court overhead around 130.03 seconds.
The opponent can still attack, and the red-shirt player must respond again. Recovery is not a proven reversal of the rally.
do_not_claim: Measured shuttle height or a measured high-clear flight.
The defensive reply made the rally safe or won initiative.
Airborne ankle projections show exact floor positions.

moments.title_zh: 等回球，不押死一种答案
observed_sequence: Gray-shirt player near the camera makes a low defensive reply around 274.05 seconds.
Red-shirt opponent moves forward from the rear and handles the next reply low around 275.0 seconds.
Gray-shirt player then makes a rear-court overhead around 276.3 seconds; the opponent returns it around 276.8 seconds and the exchange continues.
moments.alternatives: A lift and a short net reply remain coaching possibilities before the next reply is shown. These alternatives are not scored as a successful prediction.
do_not_claim: A low receiver has only one legal or physically possible reply.
The actual lift was inevitable or predicted by an accepted model.

beats.text_zh: 别只盯着这一拍怎么打，看看它给下一拍留下了什么。
红衣退到右后，又得扑向左前。
两个远点连着打，让她刚到这边，又得赶往那边。
beats.basis: The continuous tracked sequence shows rear-right reach followed by forward-left rescue; it supports the travel burden, not a measured intention.

beats.text_zh: 所以难的不只是扑救，还有起身后的下一拍。
beats.basis: The player must get up and participate in the following exchange; the rescue is not the end of the sequence.

beats.text_zh: 倒地之后，比起急着反攻，更需要先争回位的时间。
beats.basis: Visible low/on-floor state plus the conditional buy_recovery_time rule; this is a coaching interpretation, not a universal grading norm.

beats.text_zh: 回球把对手带到后场，她也争到了起身回位的时间。
beats.basis: Show the hitter's recovery before the next opponent overhead, with both players visible throughout.

beats.text_zh: 但对手还能进攻，救回来，不等于翻了盘。
beats.basis: The next attack and return are visible; no claim that this rescue won the point.

beats.text_zh: 挡短，先把对手从后场调到网前。
beats.basis: The opponent moves from rear-court attack to a low forward reception during the continuous exchange.

beats.text_zh: 接得低，也别只等挑球，还要防她回网。
beats.basis: The net_reply_options rule retains multiple replies. This is a retrospective teaching pause, not an independently scored forecast.

beats.text_zh: 这次她挑高，灰衣才有机会下压。
beats.basis: Show the actual low reply followed by the gray-shirt player's rear-court overhead; shot family remains a visual interpretation.

beats.text_zh: 又被接住了，所以还得接着判断。
beats.basis: The red-shirt player returns the overhead and the following exchange remains visible.

beats.text_zh: 先看对手在哪，再想这一拍给她什么选择。
